exposure: interval between previous CS and current delivery
outcome: vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) success rate
cohort: 100 women with a single previous lower segment cesarean section who attended the maternity unit at Al-Sadder Teaching Hospital, Missan, Iraq, between January 2016 and January 2017.
finding: 55% of the women in the study successfully delivered vaginally after a previous cesarean section, with higher success rates among women aged 15-34 years, housewives, and those with an interval of less than 2 years between the previous CS and the current delivery.
